note: What each processing tool is for in a RAVEL project and the commands the workflow reaches it through. Python libraries have no command of their own: they run inside the stage a workflow rule launches. A tool not listed here is described from its distribution metadata only.

numpy.purpose: Array arithmetic for yields, histograms and normalisation inside analysis stages.

scipy.purpose: Numerical optimisation, interpolation and distributions used by fits and limit calculations.

awkward.purpose: Jagged per-event arrays (jets, leptons) for columnar selections.

uproot.purpose: Read ROOT trees and histograms into arrays without a ROOT installation.

hist.purpose: Fill and rebin histograms with named axes and bin-wise variances.

boost-histogram.purpose: Histogram engine underneath `hist`; fills and projects multidimensional histograms.

vector.purpose: Lorentz-vector kinematics (mass, rapidity, delta-R) on awkward arrays.

iminuit.purpose: MINUIT minimiser for profile-likelihood fits and parameter intervals.

pyhf.purpose: HistFactory likelihoods and asymptotic CLs exclusion limits.

cabinetry.purpose: Build and fit HistFactory workspaces from a declarative configuration.

coffea.purpose: Columnar analysis framework: processors, weights and histogram accumulation over event chunks.

matplotlib.purpose: Render the figures a stage contracts (PDF and PNG).

mplhep.purpose: Experiment-style plot formatting on top of matplotlib.

snakemake.purpose: The project's workflow manager: runs each approved stage as a rule of the tracked Snakefile.

fsspec.purpose: Uniform file-system access (local, HTTP, remote) for input reads.

fsspec-xrootd.purpose: fsspec backend for root:// remote reads.

xrootd.purpose: Python bindings of the XRootD client for remote ROOT reads.

rucio-clients.purpose: Dataset and replica lookup on the grid data-management system.

servicex.purpose: Client for a remote columnar-transform service.

func-adl-servicex-xaodr25.purpose: Query definitions for xAOD Release 25 columns through the transform service.

pandas.purpose: Tabular summaries of yields, cutflows and scan points.

pyarrow.purpose: Columnar tables and Parquet files for intermediate stage outputs.

root.purpose: The ROOT executable: macros and interactive file inspection inside native stages.

root-config.purpose: Reports the installed ROOT version and build flags; read by the environment capture.

xrdcp.purpose: Copy a file from a remote XRootD server inside a data-staging stage.

xrdfs.purpose: List and stat remote XRootD paths inside a data-staging stage.

rucio.purpose: Grid data-management command line: dataset and replica queries.

condor_submit.purpose: Submit a batch job through the site execution backend; inspect retained submit files directly with validation only.

condor_q.purpose: Query HTCondor job state for the site execution backend.

apptainer.purpose: Run a stage inside a container image on a site without root.

pdfinfo.purpose: Report page count and fonts of a produced PDF figure.

git.purpose: Version control for the project: reads, commits and tracking of the Snakefile and skills.

ravel.purpose: RAVEL's own command line: planning, approval, workflow-manager launch, status and audit.
